# Auto-Generated Files (matugen & Theme Scripts)

These files are written by matugen (color/template engine) or its post-hooks. Changes are automatic, not manual — skip them when presenting tracked changes.

## matugen-generated (color files)

- `dotfiles/.config/hypr/colors.conf`
- `dotfiles/.config/hypr/colors.lua`
- `dotfiles/.config/waybar/colors.css`
- `dotfiles/.config/rofi/colors.rasi`
- `dotfiles/.config/gtk-3.0/colors.css`

- `dotfiles/.config/btop/themes/matugen.theme`
- `dotfiles/.config/kitty/themes/Matugen.conf`
- `dotfiles/.config/rmpc/themes/matugen.ron`
- `dotfiles/.config/hyprland-dotfiles/colors/`

## Filter Command

Use the bundled script to exclude these from git diff:

```bash
# From skill root:
bash scripts/filter-diff.sh --stat
bash scripts/filter-diff.sh --diff
bash scripts/filter-diff.sh --cached
```

Do not suggest staging or committing these files unless the user explicitly asks.
